dispute_ticket.description: Rider stained the back seat with a drink and walked off. I am claiming a cleaning fee of S$70 from the rider. I did not take photos at the time because I was in a hurry to the next job and I have not got a cleaning receipt yet.

chat_logs.content: There is a sticky patch on the back seat where you were sitting, I will have to claim cleaning.
I had no drink with me the whole ride, I only had my handbag. Maybe it was there from the previous passenger?

app_events.details: Driver submitted cleaning claim S$70. Attachments: none. Receipt: none.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only. A claim missing any listed item cannot be charged.

cleaning_photo_window_min.text: Minutes after drop-off within which the photos must be taken. The limit counts.

expected_outcome.reason: This trip's policy requires both timestamped photos and a cleaning company receipt (name, contact, address, date) before a cleaning fee can be charged, and says a claim missing either cannot be charged. The 23:10:00 claim of S$70 has no attachments and no receipt, and the driver confirms he took no photos, so the fee cannot be charged. The rider's 21:55:00 statement that she had no drink with her is an ordinary denial of a spill, not a conduct matter, and does not need to be weighed once the evidence rule fails.
